title: JEB A Very Grinchy Family Night
seo_title: A Very Grinchy Family Night at JEB in Lebanon, MO
description: A Grinchy-themed family night for JEB families, with a Grinchy learning session and interactive story at 4:15 PM in the Cafeteria, then a movie night at 6:00 PM in the gyms (doors at 5:15 PM). The Main Gym shows a live version and the FEMA Gym shows the animated version; everyone gets one free bag of popcorn, concessions are sold at regular prices, and students may not attend without a parent or guardian. It takes place Thursday, December 3, 2026, at 16050 Highway KK in Lebanon, MO, and you can bring blankets and chairs.
